content.title: Subscribe to the storefront newsletter
content.description: A shopper submits an email address to the newsletter or subscribe control, succeeds with a valid email value, and is rejected on an invalid email value instead of being silently accepted.
content.summary: Submit an email for newsletter subscription.
content.value: Supports ongoing marketing reach while preventing obviously invalid subscriber data.
criteria: The newsletter or subscribe control accepts a valid email and rejects an invalid one.
